# A call omitting a defaulted argument, run on the interpreter, in a browser
# and on bubbletea. A test reaching a component method through its handle
# reads the method's default off that handle, since the test has no `step` of
# its own. testdata/func_default_argument.txtar is the code on all five
# targets.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var n = 1

func plus(k int, by int = 2) int {
    return k + by + n
}

component counter ui.node {
    var step = 2
    var total = 0

    func add(a int, by int = step * 3) {
        total += a + by
    }

    ui.button(text="{total}", @click {
        add(1)
    })
}

func testOmittedDefaults(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(plus(1) == 4)
    c.add(1)
    t.assert(c.total == 7)
}

ui.window {
    counter()
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/counter/1 --

  ]
}
